blocks.XBASE_00: Access lift: octagonal two-storey room; the lift pad (base-floor-light) sits in a 3x5 shaft walled by grey shutter doors on both levels. Outer row/column (x=9,y=9) is solid earth like every module.
blocks.XBASE_01: Living quarters: upper level full of bunk beds in rows; lower level is a cross-shaped corridor with small side rooms (lockers, desks) and stairs up in the NE.
blocks.XBASE_02: Laboratory: upper level of white floor with lab benches, microscopes, lamps and cabinets; lower level has a corridor cross, side rooms with tables/cabinets and stairs.
blocks.XBASE_03: Workshop: upper level with two big assembly machines, robot arms, lathes, workbenches and hoists; lower level corridors and side rooms with stairs.
blocks.XBASE_04: Small radar: octagonal room with a 3x3 tilted dish in the middle, desks and cabinets around; lower level is an empty octagon with stairs (NW).
blocks.XBASE_05: Large radar: square room with four 2x2 pedestal dishes; lower level is a walled inner square holding the stairs.
blocks.XBASE_06: Missile defense: octagonal room with a central 3x3 missile silo inside an inner octagonal wall; stairs in the NE.
blocks.XBASE_07: General stores: walled bays with shelves, lockers and cabinets; lower bays closed by grey shutter doors, upper rooms by white doors.
blocks.XBASE_08: Alien containment: upper level is cells of blue glass walls on blue floor with doors; lower level has a corridor cross and side rooms (chairs, table) with stairs.
blocks.XBASE_09: Laser defense: cross-shaped room, eight 2x2 laser emitters around the walls, open centre; lower level is an inner walled square with stairs.
blocks.XBASE_10: Plasma defense: same layout as laser defense with eight 2x2 plasma emitters.
blocks.XBASE_11: Fusion ball defense: same layout with eight 2x2 fusion launchers.
blocks.XBASE_12: Grav shield: octagonal room with a grid of tall blue pylons (impassable columns, good cover); stairs below.
blocks.XBASE_13: Mind shield: octagonal room with four 2x2 purple dome generators and a desk; stairs below.
blocks.XBASE_14: Psionic lab: upper level of glass-walled cubicles each with a psi-amp station, computer desks in the south; lower level side rooms and stairs.
blocks.XBASE_15: Hyperwave decoder: octagonal room with four 2x2 decoder consoles, desks and a table.
blocks.XBASE_16: Hangar NW quarter (hangar is 2x2 blocks): wide open pale-blue floor with painted stripes, walls on north/west, a hoist and barrels; small shutter doorway in the SW.
blocks.XBASE_17: Hangar NE quarter: open striped floor, walls on north/east with a small walled alcove, a barrel.
blocks.XBASE_18: Hangar SW quarter: open striped floor, walls on west/south with a small alcove and shutter door.
blocks.XBASE_19: Hangar SE quarter: almost entirely open striped floor; earth on the outer edges.
blocks.PLANE: Skyranger (10x20, craft map): troop bay deck one level up reached by a 2-wide ramp at the north (rear) end, cockpit at the south nose, engine nacelles and wings on both sides, landing gear underneath.
blocks.AVENGER: Avenger (10x20): troop deck 4x9 one level up via a rear ramp at the north end, cockpit with consoles at the south, engine pods on the wings, landing struts below.
blocks.LIGHTNIN: Lightning (20x10): roughly round cabin one level up, seats and stands around a central pedestal, entered through a hatch from a ramp on the east side.

notes: XBASE modules are 2 storeys (MAP level 0 = lower floor with stairs and side rooms, level 1 = upper floor with the facility equipment); hangar blocks 16-19 are one open storey forming a 20x20 hangar (16 NW, 17 NE, 18 SW, 19 SE). Each 10x10 module's x=9 column and y=9 row are solid-earth and the walls have no doorways in the files: OpenXcom drills connecting corridors between adjacent modules at generation time. Block-to-facility mapping is from OpenXcom's xcom1 facilities (00 lift ... 15 hyperwave, 16-19 hangar), not stored in generated.json. Base-wall variants 12-17 look almost identical. Office chair facings are inferred from placement, not certain. PLANE is the Skyranger, not an airliner. Craft parts all have armor 255; hull pieces are impassable shaped fragments and only representative ones are named. Craft ramps rise toward +y onto the deck one level up; their levels are -4/-12/-20 so they are given as multi, not stairs (Lightning 38/39 are a normal -8/-16 pair climbing west). Avenger 51/52 (N ufo doors, open states 57/58) are not used in AVENGER.MAP; 52 mirrors 51. XBASE1 30/31 are destroyed stairs; 64-68 and 79-88 and XBASE2 53-60 are wreck forms.
